We are just minutes away from live action. England openers Tammy Beaumont and Lauren Winfield are out in the middle.

The pitch looks quite good to bat on. There will be true bounce and ball will come nicely onto the bat. If anything there will be slight help for bowlers with the new ball and NZ will be looking to take advantage of that.
THe weather here in Bristrol is slightly cloudy but it looks fine. We are in for some quality cricket here.
New Zealand ( Playing 11) :- Lauren Down, Suzie Bates, Maddy Green, Amy Satterthwaite, Sophie Devine (capt), Brooke Halliday, Katey Martin (wk), Hannah Rowe, Jess Kerr, Lea Tahuhu, Leigh Kasperek

New Zealand have won the coin toss and have elected to field first.
